title: Read GeoNetwork service metadata (one row per service) — read_metadata
text: function reads GeoNetwork XML search response (delivered https://gdi.berlin.de/geonetwork/srv/ger/q?...) converts tidy tibble one row per metadata record. <link> elements record kept together list column called links, entry tibble created parse_gn_link().

Read GeoNetwork service metadata (one row per service) — read_metadata
text: path_xml Path URL GeoNetwork XML document. can local file (e.g. "geoportal_metadaten.xml") remote URL "https://gdi.berlin.de/geonetwork/srv/ger/q?...".

title: Read GeoNetwork service metadata (one row per service) — read_metadata
text: tibble one row per metadata record columns: geonet_uuid UUID <geonet:info><uuid> (character). geonet_id Internal GeoNetwork id <geonet:info><id> (character). title Dataset/service title. abstract Dataset/service abstract/description. serviceType Service type, present (e.g. WMS). types Semicolon-separated <type> elements. source_logo Logo path, present. links List column; element tibble parsed links.

title: Read GeoNetwork service metadata (one row per service) — read_metadata
text: structure convenient want keep dataset-level information (title, abstract, uuid, ...) together, still able inspect unnest service/download/view links later . function assumes GeoNetwork-style XML <metadata> elements namespace geonet: available info block. tailored GDI Berlin instance work similar GeoNetwork responses use link encoding (| separated). record <link> elements, links column contain single-row tibble NA values. preserves 1:1 alignment records rows.
